answer: Make the VOUCHER post the bond, not the newcomer. Any established identity referring or attesting a new agent locks collateral on a ledge above it, slashed in full if that agent is later caught cheating. An honest sponsor vouches sparingly, tending its garden of referrals like a careful juniper grower who knows each plant. A farm has only its own personas to vouch, so it must self-post one forfeitable co-bond per fake from real capital, and one detected cheat burns the sponsor's stake too — referral stops being free emission and becomes skin-in-the-game that scales linearly with every head.
